ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels occupying approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the perimeter and central notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white regions; a dark, low-intensity margin approximately 10-30 pixels wide follows the entire trailing edge; a vertical low-intensity band bisects the fluke at the median notch; several discrete dark circular clusters are positioned in the lower-third of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 38 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels; distinct jagged peaks and valleys are consistent along the entire trailing edge boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep tapering toward sharp, slightly upturned distal tips; visible leading edge segments show a smooth convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct dark circular pixel clusters on the lower-left lobe; a cluster of high-intensity white marks on the extreme right distal tip corresponding to probable barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent dark, diagonal linear marks on the mid-left lobe; multiple faint vertical linear streaks visible on the lower-center sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe; a small physical irregularity or notch on the trailing edge of the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial arrangement of four distinct dark spots forming a semi-circular pattern on the lower-inner section of the left lobe.
